purpose: HMRC Income Tax liabilities statistics (15 July 2026) for the 2023-24 outturn and HMRC's 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 projections. Table 2.5 by range of total income: Income Tax payers, total income and Income Tax liabilities, the eleven published bands and the all-ranges total, consumed by the Table 2.5 growth appliers (hmrc.itl_2026.{taxpayer_count,total_income,total_tax}_growth_by_total_income_band), which move a 2023-24 SPI band row by the calendar-2025 window of the two overlapping projections over 2023-24 in the Table 2.5 band(s) the SPI band spans. Tables 2.1 (United Kingdom) and 2.2 (England, its nine regions, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland): Income Tax payers of State Pension age, consumed by the State Pension age applier (hmrc.itl_2026.resident_state_pension_age_taxpayer_growth), which moves the SPI State Pension band rows by the calendar-2025 window of the twelve region-tier areas' State Pension age taxpayers over Table 2.1's 2023-24 United Kingdom count; and Income Tax payers aged 65 and over, which no applier reads and the tests hold against the areas and the State Pension age rows (microcosm#1069).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
